text_block_list.text:
Passing by the student dorms, I noticed a 
group of Umamusume gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we begin our customary 
cleaning duty showdown?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The loser has to clean around the dorms— 
Looks like the Ritto Dorm folks will be on 
duty again this time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a lot of confidence. Granted, 
I have lost something like ten times in a 
row now...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why we need to 
win this time and let everyone let their 
hair down!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, well then, allow this one to take 
you on again this time! The greatest 
gambler in the Miho Dorms!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd rather pass on cleaning duty, so 
sorry, but I'll be taking the win again 
this time."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You stepped up after all, Nakayama. In 
this matchup, Ritto hasn't won a single 
time ever since you showed up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: However, thanks to that, the time is ripe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Accumulated defeats—the jinx of being 
unable to beat Nakayama— brings victory to 
Ritto!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san, looking forward to working 
with you♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, so they sent a jinx-breaker 
against me."

Swept up by the fiery competitive spirits 
of both sides, I couldn't help but come to 
the battleground to watch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Rules are the same as last time: 
boundaries are strictly inside this 
building. Whoever gets their swimsuit wet 
loses.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Shooting with water guns, showering them 
with water, or even cornering them into 
the pool—anything goes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Satono, Nakayama, are you both ready? 
Then, let the match... begin!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Take this! Straight-Through Shot!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not on my watch! Here's a zombie-clearing 
shot from me too!

And so, the two engaged in a dead-even 
battle for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I knew she was a young lady who liked 
defying jinxes, but I never thought she'd 
go this far.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, I like it. Things are starting to 
heat up.

"The clutch competitor Nakayama Festa is 
cornered. To counter the threat of the 
Jinx Breaker—"
choice_data_list:
Let's show them the guts of a true 
gambler!

Let's brute-force it before it turns into 
a war of attrition!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...A gambler's grit?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you mean with more passion. 
Alright, let's go with that...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ritto Dorm crowd! Listen up! If I 
lose this showdown, I'll take on cleaning 
the Ritto Dorm bathhouse, too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Well thought out. To raise the stakes 
and bet even more when backed into a 
corner."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, burning the bridges behind us, huh! 
Nakayama, now that you've declared it, 
there's no taking it back!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of taking it back, nor 
any intention of losing!

Nakayama Festa underwent a complete 
turnaround, gathering even more momentum, 
and then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mmm...! I'm so frustrated, so frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, that stacks yet another jinx onto 
the pile. Looks like the next match is 
gonna be even more heated, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! The stronger the jinx, the 
more fired up I get!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. What an amusing young lady, as 
always—

"Nakayama Festa had shown true gambler's 
grit."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Charging in without thinking is the 
height of stupidity.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, it's true that the 
odds are against us as things stand, huh. 
Tch."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The more cautious you are, the faster Lady 
Luck abandons you... Then I'll just settle 
this in one swift blow!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...!? I can't believe they're coming 
head-on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~~i!! Virtual Police Officer Shot~!

The match suddenly exploded into rapid 
action, and then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... A tie, huh? Guess breaking the jinx 
will have to wait for next time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"A frontal breakthrough in that situation 
was foolish in the end... Still, I had no 
intention of going down quietly."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So the cleaning duties will be split 
fifty-fifty between Ritto and Miho, huh. 
Well, that's a cheap price to pay for such 
a heated showdown.

Thanks to a daring strategy, Nakayama 
Festa managed to brilliantly avoid the 
worst possible outcome.
